## Cause
`Query.get_aggregation()` in `django/db/models/sql/query.py` decides when an `.aggregate()` call must wrap the queryset in a subquery. Since 4.2 (regression in 59bea9efd2), that condition checked existing aggregations, subquery refs, `qualify`, distinct, combinators… but **not window functions**. SELECT SUM("salary") AS "DJR_total",
